title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 406) reviews: Oyebanji breaks Ekiti’s second-term jinx

content.rendered:
Governor Biodun Oyebanji has made history by becoming the first democratically elected governor in Ekiti State to win two consecutive terms since 1999, securing a landslide victory across all 16 local government areas.

While supporters see the result as an endorsement of his administration’s performance, the election has also sparked conversations about low voter turnout and the importance of citizen participation ahead of the 2027 general elections.
